lineage.note: AW DEV is consumed and NEVER eligible as a new model-selection cohort. This source is independently new and preregistered before AX implementation.

hypotheses: Equal-budget random-vs-balanced public query information test distinguishes extra sampling from active query geometry. Both use identical source-new 48-response tasks and the unchanged frozen AV inverse learner.

A source-blind supervised Boolean interaction inverse can learn nonlinear relations from public FIT bit-pairs, including Feistel-family transformations, without hard-coded operators or evaluator inverses.
A public-support nearest-neighbor inverse on 48 observations can act as a nonlinear source-blind nonparametric control against learned Boolean interaction feature fitting.

fit_protocol.quadratic_basis: PUBLIC output bits, constant term, all unordered PUBLIC output-bit pairs, total 137 binary features; no operator catalog or inverse formula. Learn each of 16 PUBLIC input-bit targets using deterministic greedy sparse GF2 coordinate descent, at most 3 features/target and 2 full passes, FIT examples only.
fit_protocol.nearest_basis: 48-response task uses only first 40 PUBLIC FIT pairs, with 8 reserved CHECK rows; Hamming proximity and deterministic tie-breaking, no task-class catalog.
fit_protocol.fixed_admission: CHECK correctness at least 96/128 across 8 held public CHECK examples; graph edge inference only if admitted; original downstream 7 active + 9 retained scorer unchanged.

Yggdrasil.selection: Use only 24 TRAIN-FIT paired tasks to select at most one each category. Frozen ranking first maximize paired correct with 0 FP, then lower FN, then lower extra computation. A model can advance to held TRAIN-SCREEN only if its FIT result has >=1 positive paired correct, FP=0. Keep all six FIT arms, and SCREEN all six original frozen configurations for equal-budget comparison after FIT selection; never select based on SCREEN. No DEV if SCREEN FP>0 or no positive sensitivity.
Yggdrasil.nonlinear_success_criterion: Strict same-source held TRAIN-SCREEN FP0, >=1 paired correct on Feistel tasks, and >=1 paired correct above the best equal-public-budget affine baseline on all task pairs. Both conditions mandatory before separately approved DEV first-use.
Yggdrasil.query_success_criterion: On same-source held TRAIN-SCREEN, balanced affine 48 must strictly exceed random affine 48 paired correct with FP0 for 'active-query benefit'; otherwise only additional-information benefit can be claimed. All outcomes retained.
